prompt: A single round compass rose disc floating flat on the open sea, seen from slightly above: a thin round disc lying on the water, foreshortened into a wide ellipse, its face engraved with an eight-point compass star inside a fine ring of short plain tick marks, four long slender points and four shorter ones between them, and the one long point that aims away from the viewer, towards the top of the image, filled with seaweed green #5d7a6a. The disc, the ring, the tick marks and the other points are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading; only that one point is green. The disc carries the star and the tick marks and nothing else. From the disc, concentric ripples spread out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, dying out well before the left third of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The disc is medium-small and sits in the right half of the image with water all around it; the entire left third of the image is completely calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of seaweed green #5d7a6a on the single upper point of the star only.
